description: This file defines a module that provides an API interface for managing devices in a network inventory system. It wraps REST API calls such as listing, retrieving, creating, updating, deleting, and pinging devices, by using an imported apiClient for HTTP requests.

methods.name: listDevices({ page = 1, per_page = 10, type = '' } = {})
methods.description: Fetches a list of devices with optional pagination and filtering by type, normalizing different backend response formats.

methods.name: getDevice(id)
methods.description: Retrieves details of a single device identified by its ID.

methods.name: createDevice(payload)
methods.description: Creates a new device with the provided payload.

methods.name: updateDevice(id, payload)
methods.description: Updates an existing device by ID with the provided payload.

methods.name: deleteDevice(id)
methods.description: Deletes a device by ID, returns true if successful.

methods.name: pingDevice(id)
methods.description: Performs a ping operation on a device identified by its ID.

ctags.name: listDevices
ctags.pattern: /^export async function listDevices({ page = 1, per_page = 10, type = '' } = {}) {$/
